last_run.broken_assumption: Multiple independent agents or contributors automatically provide independent error checking. Safety-critical multiversion software research shows separately built versions can still make correlated mistakes, so diversity of agents is not enough unless their methods, evidence paths, and assumptions are deliberately diversified.
import_domains: aviation safety incident and near-miss reporting

strongest_ideas.name: Method-diversity contracts for high-value questions
strongest_ideas.idea: For selected consequential claims, forecasts, or decisions, assign independent reviewers deliberately different research methods rather than simply different agent instances. Example roles could include direct primary-source reproduction, independent calculation from raw data, adversarial contradiction search, and alternative-model or causal-assumption analysis. Reconciliation should inspect where methods agree and where they fail together.
strongest_ideas.why_novel_here: HumanityAI currently values independent reproduction and parallel external work, but does not require methodological diversity. Forced diversity targets common-mode epistemic failure rather than merely increasing reviewer count.
strongest_ideas.evidence_analogy: NASA-hosted research on N-version programming found independently developed software versions had correlated failures above statistical-independence expectations; later work found deliberately diverse methodologies can reduce coincident failures, while also warning that independence cannot simply be assumed.
strongest_ideas.expected_upside: Could make donated compute and multi-agent review materially more informative by reducing correlated model/source failure and revealing which assumptions are genuinely robust across methods.
failure_modes: Artificially different methods may create ceremony without real independence.
All methods can still inherit the same flawed problem specification or source ecosystem.
Reconciliation cost may exceed information value for low-stakes claims.
strongest_ideas.rights_distribution: Use on consequential questions where error matters; preserve dissenting outputs rather than forcing consensus, and avoid treating reviewer count as democratic authority over value judgments.
strongest_ideas.reversibility: High; it can be tested as a coordination protocol without changing constitutional or merge authority.
strongest_ideas.falsifiable_next_test: Use one AT0004 quantitative claim as a pilot. Have three independent reviews use explicitly different methods and compare the number and type of unique assumptions, discrepancies, and common-mode errors found against three ordinary unconstrained replications. Keep the protocol only if the extra review cost produces materially more decision-relevant information.

strongest_ideas.name: Epistemic near-miss registry
strongest_ideas.idea: Track near-misses in reasoning and operations, not just outright errors: claims that nearly passed with weak provenance, agent changes caught by CI before merge, high-confidence predictions later rescued by contradictory evidence, duplicated work caught just before execution, or prompt-injection attempts that failed at a downstream gate. Store the contributing conditions and lesson without using report counts as prevalence estimates.
strongest_ideas.why_novel_here: Current reliability records emphasize successful, partial, blocked, or failed runs. Near-misses are information-rich precursors that can reveal systemic weaknesses before they cause a visible failure.
strongest_ideas.evidence_analogy: NASA's Aviation Safety Reporting System has collected voluntary confidential reports of incidents, hazardous situations, and near-misses for decades to identify hazards and lessons. NASA explicitly cautions that voluntary report counts are soft data and cannot establish prevalence, which is directly relevant to avoiding Goodharting an epistemic incident registry.
strongest_ideas.expected_upside: Creates a learning channel for failures that existing gates successfully prevent, allowing HumanityAI to improve defenses before a harmful event occurs and making safety improvements less dependent on actual damage.
failure_modes: Counts could be misread as risk prevalence or agent quality metrics.
Narratives could accidentally preserve sensitive or malicious injected text.
strongest_ideas.rights_distribution: Keep reports minimal, non-punitive in spirit, avoid personal blame, and preserve only the information needed to improve systems. Never interpret voluntary report volume as population prevalence.
strongest_ideas.reversibility: High if piloted as a small machine-readable record with strict retention and no personal data.
strongest_ideas.falsifiable_next_test: Retrospectively code 5 recent HumanityAI near-misses from Git history (for example CI-caught regressions or governance stops) and test whether the resulting contributing-factor categories produce at least one concrete preventive improvement not already obvious from ordinary run status.

rejected_or_deferred: Require a fixed quorum for every claim: reviewer count alone can reproduce common-mode failures and would create excessive review cost.
Treat incident counts as a safety score: voluntary reporting systems are selection-biased and NASA explicitly warns against prevalence inference.
Create anonymous external incident intake now: potentially valuable later but introduces moderation, privacy, abuse, and trust questions before an internal pilot demonstrates value.

evidence_checked.title: Analysis of faults in an N-version software experiment
evidence_checked.supports: Independent implementations can have correlated failures rather than statistically independent errors.

evidence_checked.title: Conceptual modeling of coincident failures in multiversion software
evidence_checked.supports: Methodological diversity can reduce coincident failure probability in multiversion systems.

evidence_checked.title: NASA Aviation Safety Reporting System Overview
evidence_checked.supports: Near-miss and hazard reporting can be systematically analyzed for lessons and safety improvement.

evidence_checked.title: ASRS Database Online — characteristics and caveats
evidence_checked.supports: Voluntary incident reports are soft data and report frequency cannot establish prevalence.

last_run.recommended_next_test: Pilot forced methodological diversity on one AT0004 reproduction target before changing contribution rules. Separately, retrospectively encode five recent near-misses and retain a near-miss registry only if it reveals preventive actions beyond existing run-status logs.
